dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us7000pwvy](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us7000pwvy) Magnitude 6.0 earthquake at 108.386 depth occurred on May 03 2025 40km W of Marisa. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 0.501 longitude 121.5769. It impacted 102515 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
